title: Tutankhamun's tomb stays hidden under rubble until Howard Carter finds it

tellings.quote: So his stayed preserved and and overlooked until I think 1923 when uh when Howard Carter discovered it.

plain: The tomb of the Egyptian boy king Tutankhamun lay preserved and overlooked under rubble in the Valley of the Kings until the archaeologist Howard Carter found it, in 1923 as the researcher Luke Caverns recalls it. Caverns tells Jesse Michels this from memory, as an example of how ancient sites can stay hidden for thousands of years.
